basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old gamer from Toronto, Canada, who recently switched from console to PC gaming. I work as a software engineer during the day and unwind with some gaming at night. I have a keen interest in strategy games and love exploring gaming communities online. I'm single, and my schedule is flexible, so I often find myself online during late evenings. I dislike toxic behavior and enjoy sharing tips and insights with fellow gamers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, with a degree from the University of Waterloo. My interest in gaming started in childhood and has evolved into a passion for both playing and developing games. I keep myself updated with the latest in gaming technology through forums and personal research.
